analysis.benefit_rule: For both canonical and paraphrase questions, v2 correct numeric coverage must exceed both references by at least 0.10 in the company-macro average; v2 wrong numeric answers must be no greater than either reference in either style; all 64 required abstentions must be correct. All outputs must be complete and source spans valid.
analysis.primary: Company-macro correct numeric coverage on the 164 answerable cases, reported for each question style and reference.
analysis.total_cost: Report full preparation, each arm process, checking and collection separately; each parent is counted once with its waited descendants.
analysis.uncertainty: Exact finite-roster counts and paired deltas. Three companies and eight related tables support a controlled coverage finding; broader population intervals require a broader independently sampled roster.

execution.engineering_fixture: Only invented source fixtures or the five previously opened cases may be executed locally.
execution.host_package_and_budget: next after the controller is verified
execution.order: Sort opaque case IDs; rotate arm order by pass modulo three. Every arm has the same case order.

normalization: Each selected source cell becomes a separate sentence with its unchanged label, year, value and explicit USD scale. The shareholder inputs use dollar wealth from a common $100 base; their return-difference targets use percentage points. Normalization is fixed and charged as preparation.
question_authorship: Codex authored fixed canonical templates and paired plain-English variants before any fresh predictor calls. Both styles use the same source facts and gold operation.
retrieval_faults: ask an under-specified label with several eligible series
add the prior-year amount under the requested year as an explicit retrieval-error injection
scope: Constructed source-grounded question coverage for the fixed arithmetic controls. Document and complete-input freshness are relative to the opened 1,147-case set. Company overlap is reported.
source_selection: Microsoft, Apple and Costco fiscal 2025 reports. Income and balance tables for each; two available HTML shareholder tables. Costco uses the company-hosted XBRL presentation of its 10-K.

split.development: separate invented source fixtures and the five previously opened cases
split.evaluation: all 228 new cases; family and question-style pairs stay together for analysis

target_policy.abstention: prediction and exact_result must both be null; retain the reason and any selected source spans.
target_policy.evidence_scope: Answerability is determined from supplied evidence. Missing or contradictory required facts require abstention.
target_policy.negative_difference: excess and change mean signed subtraction; a negative result is valid.
target_policy.numeric: Compare output exact_result and unit to the independent rational target rounded half away from zero to two decimals. Also verify the printed numeric answer agrees with exact_result.
